articles.title: CCO’s SUVIKALP Initiative Advances Sustainable Mine Repurposing, Receives SKOCH Gold Award 2026
articles.description: New Delhi: The Coal Controller Organisation (CCO), under the Ministry of Coal, has undertaken initiatives to promote scientific mine closure and sustainable repurposing of post-mining land. CCO has developed SUVIKALP, an in-house Mine Repurposing Tool, to assist stakeholders in selecting suitable mine repurposing projects through a structured and data-driven decision-making process. articles.title: SSS Defence Wins UP Police Order for 90 Indigenous P-72 Assault Rifles
articles.description: The Uttar Pradesh Police initiated the procurement process on 7 April 2026, inviting bids for 90 automatic assault rifles chambered for 7.62×39 mm ammunition. The tender closed on 22 April, with the subsequent procurement process including technical evaluation and competitive price bidding.
